stem:
Bhavna traces a path on square-grid paper. One segment runs $4$ straight grid units along the lines; the next segment cuts diagonally across one square.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims about the path length are correct?

options.text: The straight segment measures $4$ straight grid units along the lines.
The diagonal segment has the same unit length as one straight grid step.
The diagonal segment must be measured or estimated as its own length, not counted as one straight grid unit.
The path length is the printed label "square-grid paper".

teacher.key_rationale: Straight grid steps and diagonal cuts can have different unit lengths, so the 4-unit straight part and the separately estimated diagonal are both needed. Treating the diagonal as one straight unit omits that difference. Calling the paper label the length swaps terms.
